original_question: Show only the acceptance obligations of KM-500c-2; omit its test plan.

target_ids.KM-500c-2: Literal identifier in the original question; assess its requested role.

required_fields.canonical_id: The stable identities of the requested entities, such as which tests or ACs.
required_fields.kind: The canonical entity type of each returned item.
required_fields.title: The source-backed human-readable name of each returned item.
required_fields.source_sha: The immutable source revision supporting each entity.
required_fields.source_locator: The exact source location supporting each entity.
required_fields.priority: Declared source priority, not an inferred business ranking or dependency count.
required_fields.test_required: The explicit source test requirement, not evidence of execution.
required_fields.work_status: Implementation progress, such as done or todo; distinct from lifecycle status.
required_fields.status: Canonical lifecycle status, such as active; not delivery completion.
required_fields.criteria: Exact source acceptance clauses defining required behavior; distinct from the authored verification specification.
required_fields.readiness: Planning approval readiness, not implementation proof.
required_fields.covered_by: Declared test references, not evidence of a test run.
required_fields.implemented_by: Declared implementation references, not a complete call graph.
required_fields.depends_on: Declared requirement dependencies, not inferred code impact.
required_fields.content: Bounded source text at the canonical locator; not a full-document promise
required_fields.test_spec: Authored verification obligations: test scenarios, expected assertions, test angles and wrong implementations the checks must catch; distinct from acceptance clauses, test references and execution results.

document_types.ac_yaml: Canonical acceptance criterion definition, including acceptance clauses and any authored verification specification

relationships.all_descendants: Entire declared hierarchy below the target, not only direct children
relationships.declared_dependents: Records directly declaring a dependency on the target
relationships.covered_by: Tests declared to cover an acceptance criterion
relationships.governing_adrs: ADRs directly declaring membership in the target component
relationships.component_context: The target component and its directly linked neighbors, bounded by requested result kind
